name: Gross sales (INR)
definition: Value of goods sold at list line price before discount and tax: quantity sold x unit price, summed. Channel is the outlet's channel on the day of the sale.
grain: Sale line; reported by day x channel, rolled up to week, month, fiscal quarter
filters_exclusions: Duplicate lines removed (key txn_id + txn_line_no). Sale date is the IST date of event_ts, not the ingest date. Fiscal year runs April to March.
known_limitations: Price basis is a judgement: unit_price is treated as price per sale unit (per case on case lines). Pricing per each would make monthly sales jump 3.7x at the 2025-10 schema change; shown as gross_sales_inr_alt_basis. Channel by outlet master moves a large share of sales versus the till channel.

name: Net sales (INR)
definition: Gross sales minus line discount, before tax.
known_limitations: Discount_amount on case lines is computed by the source on the case count, as tax is. Not corrected.

name: Units sold (eaches)
definition: Quantity sold expressed in single units: each lines as captured, case lines multiplied by eaches per case (uom_conversion table, falling back to product master case_pack).
filters_exclusions: Duplicates removed. Sale date in IST.
known_limitations: Before 2025-10-01 the feed has no unit-of-measure column, so those lines are assumed to be eaches. Months before October 2025 are therefore not comparable with later months. 46 SKUs are missing from the conversion table and use case_pack.

name: Basket count
definition: Distinct shopper baskets: distinct (basket_id, outlet) within a sale day.
known_limitations: basket_id alone spans several outlets and days for about 65% of baskets, so it cannot identify a basket by itself. The composite is a best effort and may still merge two shoppers.

name: Cold chain excursion rate (reading level)
definition: Readings above 8 C divided by valid readings, after converting Fahrenheit to Celsius and correcting device clocks. The contract defines an excursion as any reading above the 2-8 C band; readings below 2 C are tracked separately and not counted.
grain: Reading; reported by month, warehouse, vendor
filters_exclusions: Duplicate readings removed. Null readings excluded from the denominator. Every reefer reading is treated as chilled (no chilled flag exists).
owner_proposed: Divya Raghavan, Head of Supply Chain Operations
known_limitations: Raw readings show about 38% over 8, which is the Fahrenheit vendor read as Celsius; the corrected rate is about 7.2%. Carrier breakdown is impossible: nothing in telemetry links to a carrier. 8% of rows have no unit and use the vendor to infer it. Gateway outages create gaps, not nulls.
confidence: HIGH for the rate, NOT AVAILABLE by carrier

name: Cold chain trip breach rate (proxy)
definition: Share of device-days with at least one reading above 8 C. A device-day stands in for a trip.
owner_proposed: Divya Raghavan, Head of Supply Chain Operations
known_limitations: There is no trip id, and one device-day carries about 19 readings and many route codes, so this measures how long a device was watched, not trips. About 75% of device-days breach. Do not quote it as a trip rate. Needs a trip table from operations.

name: Dock-to-dispatch cycle time (hours)
definition: Hours from the first RECEIVE scan to the last DISPATCH scan for the same order at the same warehouse, median by warehouse. Pairs over a cap (default 24 hours) are treated as unmatched scans.
grain: Order x warehouse; reported by warehouse
filters_exclusions: Missing scans (about 6.5% never emitted) leave orders unmeasured. Dispatch before receive is excluded.
owner_proposed: Divya Raghavan, Head of Supply Chain Operations
known_limitations: Scans of one order fall on about 4.7 different days and only a small share of orders has both scans at one site. The uncapped median is thousands of hours, which is not real. Result is indicative only and coverage is reported beside it. Timestamps are site local (all Asia/Kolkata).

name: Outlet channel changes
definition: Outlets whose master channel changed between versions, with the date of change and the old and new channel.
filters_exclusions: Master inserts and updates only. A delete does not create a version.
known_limitations: Change time is the commit time in the ERP (UTC). Order of changes uses (op_ts, seq), never the extract date.

name: Order value by source system
definition: Gross order value from the order header, by source system, on the latest version of each order. A freight-adjusted value divides PARTNER_API rows by 1.085.
filters_exclusions: Deleted orders excluded (a delete is terminal).
known_limitations: The sources are not comparable as reported: PARTNER_API runs about 8.5% high. The factor is read off the data; there are no invoices to confirm it. source_system and outlet_code change between versions of one order, so source is shown both at insert and at latest version.

name: Service level (on-time delivery)
definition: Not defined: it needs a delivery date, and none exists.
owner_proposed: Divya Raghavan, Head of Supply Chain Operations
known_limitations: No order ever reaches DELIVERED and there is no delivery timestamp. Needs proof-of-delivery data from transport.

name: Gap to the Finance weekly report
definition: Kestrel gross sales less the published legacy weekly figure, split into duplicates counted by the legacy method, ingest date versus sale date, and channel reclassification, plus what remains unexplained.
grain: Legacy week (7 days ending Wednesday, anchored 2025-01-01) x channel
filters_exclusions: Only weeks the legacy report covers (to 2026-06-24).
known_limitations: The legacy figures have no usable relationship to the raw feed (weekly correlation near zero). The bridge accounts for duplicates and timing only; the remainder is unexplained and cannot be closed from the data. Legacy channel is assumed to be the till channel.

name: Missing data
definition: Unreadable files, partitions short of the manifest, feed-days that are empty or under half their trailing 28-day average, and gateway-days with no readings.
grain: Feed x day; gateway x day
known_limitations: Feed-level volume checks do not see gateway outages: the GW-017 gap is only visible at gateway x day grain. The manifest does not cover the ERP feeds and was written before the truncated file.
